request.label: outlet-qual-cp1-publish
command:
set -o pipefail
cd "$1"
test ! -e evidence/outlet-qual-cp1.tar.gz
partial=evidence/outlet-qual-cp1.tar.gz.work-$$
trap 'rm -f -- "$partial"' EXIT
tar -I 'gzip -1' -cf "$partial" evidence/outlet-qual-cp4-replay.json evidence/outlet-qual-b3-admission*.json evidence/outlet-qual-b3-*-forecast.json   evidence/outlet-B3-audit*.json evidence/outlet-qual-B3-B2.json evidence/outlet-qual-b3-blend-probe.json   operations/outlet-qual-cp4-replay* operations/outlet-qual-b3* science/outlet-qual-b3*   tools/outlet-qual-drivers/cp1-* tools/outlet-qual-drivers/b3-* tools/outlet-control-v7 tools/outlet-control-v8 tools/outlet-python-v1{5,6,7,8,9}/h27/task2_outlet*.py accounting.json
tar -tzf "$partial" > /dev/null
mv -- "$partial" evidence/outlet-qual-cp1.tar.gz

request.label: outlet-qual-b3-affinity-preflight
command:
for cpu in 0 2 14; do
  actual=$(mpirun -np 1 --bind-to none taskset --cpu-list "$cpu" /bin/sh -c 'awk "/^Cpus_allowed_list:/ {print \$2}" /proc/self/status')
  test "$actual" = "$cpu"
  printf "Rank wrapper CPU %s verified\n" "$actual"
done
